clauses.heading: Cover: windstorm and cyclone
clauses.text: The insurer covers physical loss or damage to the insured building caused by windstorm or cyclone, subject to the policy limit and deductible.

clauses.heading: Cover: fire
clauses.text: The insurer covers loss or damage by fire, lightning and explosion to the insured property.

clauses.heading: Exclusion: flood without flood extension
clauses.text: Loss caused by flood, river overflow or inundation is excluded unless the flood extension has been purchased.

clauses.heading: Endorsement: cyclone deductible CE-2
clauses.text: Where endorsement CE-2 applies, a separate percentage deductible of the sum insured may apply to windstorm and cyclone claims.

clauses.heading: Condition: prompt notice
clauses.text: The insured must notify the insurer of a loss within 7 days of becoming aware of it.

clauses.heading: Exclusion: unoccupancy
clauses.text: Loss occurring while the premises have been unoccupied for more than 30 consecutive days is excluded.

clauses.heading: Cover: flood add-on FL-1
clauses.text: Where add-on FL-1 is held, loss from flood to the insured vehicle is covered subject to the sum insured.

clauses.heading: Exclusion: driving under influence
clauses.text: Loss arising while the insured driver is under the influence of alcohol or drugs is excluded.

clauses.heading: Sub-limit: named storm
clauses.text: Losses from a named storm are payable up to the named storm sub-limit of INR 40,00,000 in aggregate per period of insurance.

clauses.heading: Procedure: proof of loss
clauses.text: Claims require a completed claim form and proof of the loss amount, such as an invoice or repair estimate. Incomplete claims may be held pending these documents.

required_documents_why.claim_form: Records the insured's account of the loss.
required_documents_why.repair_estimate: Gives an independent amount to check the reported loss against.
required_documents_why.invoice: Confirms the amount actually charged for repairs or replacement.
required_documents_why.photos: Shows the condition of the damaged item.
required_documents_why.vehicle_registration: Confirms the vehicle details match the policy.
required_documents_why.fire_report: Confirms the fire and its cause from an official source.
required_documents_why.proof_of_ownership: Confirms insurable interest in the damaged item.
required_documents_why.police_report: Confirms the theft from an official source.
required_documents_why.medical_or_liability_documentation: Supports the injury or third-party claim.
required_documents_why.income_statement: Supports the business interruption loss amount.
required_documents_why.proof_of_payment: Confirms costs the business actually paid.

notice: All records are fictional demo data. Hazard alerts are simulated and must not be represented as official forecasts.
